title: Filling: single or dual wheels, adding and removing axles, row units
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. A template with a Per axle field with multiple axles. Seed it: Settings - Service > Inspection Templates > New template (or Edit), use Add field to add the fields, then Save.
  3. Fill it on desktop and on a phone.
custom_steps:
1. Switch an axle between Single and Dual and confirm entered values are preserved with no warning (Single keeps the outer readings as left/right; switching back restores the inner readings; preserved values live for the session only).
2. Confirm the first axle can never be deleted but carries a clear action that empties its readings/verdicts and leaves it in place; any axle after the first can be deleted and those below move up and renumber.
3. Confirm axles expand one at a time or all at once, and opening one does not collapse another.
4. Confirm desktop and phone are two layouts (phone renders one card per measurement row, no sideways scroll), and changing a row's unit while filling applies across the whole axle for that row only, not other rows or axles.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Switching an axle between Single and Dual preserves what was entered with no warning (Single keeps the outer readings as left and right; switching back restores the inner readings), and preserved values live for the session only.
  • The first axle can never be deleted but carries a clear action that empties its readings and verdicts and leaves the axle in place.
  • Any axle after the first can be deleted, and axles below a deleted one move up and the numbering follows.
  • Axles can be expanded one at a time or all at once, and opening one does not collapse another.
  • Desktop and phone are two layouts rather than one compressed; the phone renders one card per measurement row and does not scroll sideways.
  • The technician can change a row's unit while filling; the change applies to that row across the whole axle and does not touch the other rows or axles.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9106 (S8 — Record measurements per axle); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S8; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R17: “Switching an axle between Single and Dual will preserve what was entered, with no warning and no confirmation. Switching to Single keeps the outer readings as the left and right values; switching back restores the inner readings. Preserved values will live for the session only”
  • S8-R20: “The first axle can never be deleted. It will carry a clear action that empties its readings and verdicts and leaves the axle in place”
  • S8-R21: “Any axle after the first can be deleted. Axles below a deleted one will move up, and the numbering will follow”
  • S8-R22: “Axles can be expanded one at a time or all at once. Opening one will not collapse another”
  • S8-R23: “Desktop and phone will be two layouts rather than one layout compressed. The phone will render one card per measurement row and will not scroll sideways”
  • S8-R27: “The technician will be able to change a row's unit while filling. The change applies to that row across the whole axle, so every position on it is read in one unit, and it does not touch the other rows or the other axles”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
